episodes.title: The Drawing Badge
episodes.summary: It is raining, so Duggee and the Squirrels stay indoors to do some drawing. Can anybody guess what Duggee has drawn?

episodes.title: The Cake Badge
episodes.summary: Happy finds a cake lying around in the field and decides to eat it. But whose cake is it?

episodes.title: The Hair Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is having a bad hair day. Can the Squirrels help him at all?

episodes.title: The Summer Holiday Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are out tobogganing with Duggee when they spot a migrating bird falling from the sky.

episodes.title: The Rescue Badge
episodes.summary: Enid the cat is stuck up the tree. How will Duggee and the Squirrels get her down?

episodes.title: The Super Squirrel Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels decide they want to be superheroes. Is there anyone that needs their help?

episodes.title: The Jam Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is making jam, but Naughty Monkey steals all of Duggee's fruit. Can the Squirrels help catch him?

episodes.title: The Treasure Hunt Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels find a treasure map inside Duggee's big shiny ruby. X marks the spot!

episodes.title: The Scarecrow Badge
episodes.summary: The birds keep eating Duggee's grain, so the Squirrels build an enormous scarecrow to frighten them away.

episodes.title: The Funny Face Badge
episodes.summary: Whoooooo the Shamanistic Owl looks a bit down. How can the squirrels cheer her up? Maybe Duggee can do some juggling, or perhaps Happy can do some beat boxing.

episodes.title: The Bouncing Badge
episodes.summary: It is Tag's birthday and Duggee has put up a bouncy castle to celebrate. It's a lovely sunny day, and the squirrels are all excited. They are just about to get bouncing when a big, gloomy cloud settles down and falls asleep right over the bouncy castle. How can they wake it up? Well, they could bounce up and tell it to move. Is this something Hedgley the hedgehog can help them with?

episodes.title: The Leaf Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels go for a woodland walk to help Duggee look for a very special leaf when they hear the strangest noise. In the distance, they can see a funny shape. What is that noise? What is that shape? Maybe it's a monster? No, wait! It's only Hedgley the hedgehog, who has been trundling around the forest collecting all sorts of leaves and twigs on his spiky quills, which make him look and sound like a leafy monster.

episodes.title: The Omelette Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee decides to make an omelette, but there are no eggs in the basket. Where are all the chickens, and why aren't they laying any eggs? The chickens need some exercise! Thank goodness for Hennie the ostrich and her exercise fitness. Watch the Squirrels work out with the chickens to Hennie's funky tunes.

episodes.title: The Food Growing Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is sowing seeds. The Squirrels ask if they can grow something too. Onion! Carrot! Cucumber! Pumpkin! And strawberry! Who grows what, and how big will they be? One of the Squirrels is in for an enormous surprise!

episodes.title: The Paddling Pool Badge
episodes.summary: It's a scorcher of a day. Luckily, Duggee has a big paddling pool. Yippee!First of all, they need help with blowing up the pool and filling it with water. Thank goodness for Ethel the elephant, she can do everything.Time for the Squirrels to have lots of fun. Watch Tag, Betty, Norrie, Happy and Roly and all their animal friends have fun in the pool under the watchful eye of lifeguard Duggee.

episodes.title: The Paper Boat Badge
episodes.summary: Wow, Duggee is clever - he shows the Squirrels how to make a paper boat out of the sheets of his newspaper. And look, it floats! As they all look on in admiration, an army of ants interrupt. They need help to get across to the other side of the pond so they can join a picnic. Happy comes up with a very good idea - to make the ants a big paper boat. Duggee and the Squirrels make the ants a huge paper boat and waft them over to the other side of the pond. Tiny ant-sized hotdogs are their prize.

episodes.title: The Castle Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels hear an echoing voice coming from the top of a castle's spooky tower. Someone is calling them - but who is it? Duggee and the Squirrels go off to investigate, but first they have to get inside the castle. Good job Duggee knows how. Prepare to be taken on a huge chase around the castle before the Squirrels finally discover who is making all that mischief and noise at the top of the castle.

episodes.title: The Show and Tell Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee has something really interesting to show the Squirrels but it's a bit prickly. The Squirrels go off into the garden to find their own interesting things to show and tell, and they all make very different choices. Norrie finds a very special creature with six spots. Can you guess what it is?

episodes.title: The Rocking Horse Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is cleaning out his cupboard when he comes across Bucky, his old rocking horse. He wants to show the Squirrels how to ride the horse but Bucky is very old and needs to be fixed first. The Squirrels help Duggee to mend Bucky so he feels brand new again and in return they get to ride him. Cowboy, circus trapeze artist, knight in shining armour, racing jockey! It's all happening in the clubhouse! Yee-haw!

episodes.title: The Get Well Soon Badge
episodes.summary: Oh dear, poor Norrie is sick. Can the Squirrels think of something to cheer her up? Happy suggests a get well soon card! What a good idea! Glitter, glue, feathers and paint! Duggee takes the Squirrels to visit Norrie, but along the way they come across a hungry panda, a poorly frog and a coughing caterpillar. Can the Squirrels think of how to cheer them up too?

episodes.title: The Hiccup Badge
episodes.summary: It's a lovely day, so Duggee and the Squirrels are outside. They bump into worm, but oh dear! He has swallowed too much mud and he is making a funny noise. Hic! Worm has got the hiccups. The Squirrels think it's very funny, until they get the hiccups too. Hic hic! Will Duggee be able to help them find a cure or will he start hiccupping too?

episodes.title: The Maze Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is cleaning out the workshop but it's a very big job and he needs the Squirrels' help. There is a lot of stuff to carry out before they can clean up, and some of it is very interesting. The Squirrels work hard but when they finish they can't find Duggee. Oh! The Squirrels have built a maze out of all the things in Duggee's workshop. Duggee is right in the middle of the maze, but can the Squirrels find the right way in? And once they're in, can they find the way out again?

episodes.title: The Raindance Badge
episodes.summary: It's a very hot day and Duggee's flowers are looking very sad. What can perk them up? Some water of course, but there's not a drop to be found. They need a bit of rain, but it's far too sunny today. How can they make the rain come? What about the rain dance! Who knows how to do a great dance? Duggee, of course! Duggee teaches the Squirrels the best rain dance ever and it really does work well. Now they can all do their crazy dancing in the rain!

episodes.title: The Acorn Badge
episodes.summary: Norrie is upset when she sees a leaf fall from the tree. She thinks it's broken. She soon cheers up when she finds out that some trees shed their leaves in autumn, and actually it's quite good fun playing and jumping in piles of leaves. But ouch! What has Roly found stuck to his bottom? It's an acorn. Duggee explains that lots of forest animals collect acorns to eat in the winter, so the Squirrels decide to look and find lots of acorns to share out for everyone.

episodes.title: The Balloon Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is blowing up balloons for Tino the artistic mouse's birthday. The Squirrels are a little worried because Tino can be a bit grumpy! But Duggee persuades them all to go and see Tino and give him a bunch of balloons. When you give a tiny mouse a big bunch of balloons, something unexpected happens. Tino starts to float up into the sky! He's having a rather good time, until he gets stuck in a tree. It's time for the Squirrels to come to his rescue.

episodes.title: The Tinsel Badge
episodes.summary: It's nearly Christmas and Duggee is wrapping presents to go under the tree. He asks the Squirrels if they want to help decorate the clubhouse for Christmas. Of course they do! But they don't just want to decorate the clubhouse; they want to decorate everything - including Duggee and Enid the cat! Out comes the tinsel, baubles and chains, then some more tinsel, and lights to go everywhere. What a lovely Christmassy clubhouse! To top it off the Squirrels have got Christmas presents for everyone - but where has Enid gone?

episodes.title: The Hide and Seek Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels decide to play hide-and-seek. Duggee counts to ten while the Squirrels go off and hide. They have hidden in really good places, but Duggee finds them all - except Roly. He's not in the tent. He's not in the clubhouse. He doesn't seem to be anywhere outside. Where could he be? Maybe the cows have seen where Roly is hiding.

episodes.title: The Sheep Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing with their toys when they notice that there is a sheep in the clubhouse. Wait a minute! There are sheep everywhere! Inside and out! How did that happen? Oh no, someone has left the paddock gate open! Can the Squirrels help Duggee herd the sheep back to the paddock?

episodes.title: The Spider Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing in the clubhouse when Norrie discovers a spider in the dressing-up box. Everywhere Norrie goes the spider seems to go too. Aarrrggh! That's a bit scary!Duggee and the Squirrels decide to put the spider outside, but now they can't find him anywhere. They do find something though... a giant spiderweb!

episodes.title: The We Love Animals Badge
episodes.summary: When Duggee strokes Enid the cat, the Squirrels want to find animals they can stroke too. Roly wants to stroke a bird, but they keep flying off. Betty finds a turtle, but he feels a bit too hard. Happy tries to stroke a goldfish - but it's a bit too wet. Hedgley the hedgehog is too spiky for Norrie, and Tag discovers that a slug is a bit sticky. Can anyone find a soft and cuddly animal to stroke?

episodes.title: The Snowman Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels play outside in the snow and decide to build a jolly looking snowman. But when the punky penguins turn up and poke fun at it, the competition really hots up. The Squirrels make a snow slug and then the penguins make a snow bird. Each new snow creation trumps the last and they get bigger, better and more exciting. And in the end, the very best is something they have all made together... an enormous snow slide!

episodes.title: The Decorating Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is painting the clubhouse. The Squirrels ask if they can help too, but they have some different colours in mind and, with the help of Tino the artistic mouse, some new painting techniques to throw in the mix. Leaf patterns, finger printing and potato stamps - what will Duggee think of the clubhouse's new look? And what colour will it be? Aquamarine blue? Early spring green, wild violet purple or crimson sunrise red? Or a brilliant mixture of everything?

episodes.title: The Tidy-Up Badge
episodes.summary: It is time for a Squirrel clubhouse spring clean. Duggee is dusting when the doorbell goes and a big package arrives for him. What is it? Duggee has bought an amazing new hoover, but it's very powerful. Duggee and the Squirrels start tidying up the clubhouse so they can make good use of the brand new hoover. It's all going very well until Roly pushes the wrong button...

episodes.title: The Circus Badge
episodes.summary: The circus has come to town and the Squirrels are very excited until they see that it is a flea circus. It is so tiny! It doesn't seem very impressive until they get to see some of the acts, like Fifi and her daring tightrope act and the flea cannonball. The Squirrels are eager to get involved, especially when they see what the strong flea can do - now that's impressive!

episodes.title: The Egg Badge
episodes.summary: One of the chickens is laying her eggs. One chick, two chicks and OOPS! The third chick's legs pop out of the bottom of the egg. Oh dear, it's a little bit stuck! Wait a minute - the egg is running off! Can the Squirrels help bring it back to the chicken safely? There's a big world out there to explore so the Squirrels need to be quick. Oh, and they must make sure they find the right egg to return!

episodes.title: The Puppy Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee's nephew Dugley comes to stay. He is one cute puppy, but he looks like he could cause chaos in the clubhouse. And what's that terrible smell? The Squirrels come up with lots of imaginative ways to entertain him but there is only one character that can stop him crying. Who do you think it could be?

episodes.title: The Cardboard Box Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee gets a delivery, which arrives in a big cardboard box. The Squirrels discover that cardboard boxes can be very interesting - Roly makes a car out of one, Tag makes a tunnel and then all the squirrels make the biggest cardboard castle ever seen. They dress up as brave knights in cardboard costumes, but when they get to their castle, they discover it is already occupied by those naughty mice!

episodes.title: The Caterpillar Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are helping Duggee in the garden when Tag makes friends with a caterpillar. This caterpillar is very hungry, so Tag feeds her all the vegetable leaves they have been picking. She eats and eats and eats and gets bigger and bigger. Wow! The other Squirrels are really keen to play with her too, but Tag's caterpillar friend is suddenly very tired and needs to sleep. The Squirrels are also a bit sleepy, time for a nap! When the Squirrels wake up, they cannot find caterpillar - she has disappeared. In her place, as if by magic, there is someone else. How did that happen?

episodes.title: The Sandcastle Badge
episodes.summary: It's lovely and warm - just right for a day on the beach. The Squirrels learn how to make sandcastles - dig, dig, dig! They are doing such a good job that Jon and Nigel ask the crabs if the Squirrels could work together to build them a new home. They create the most spectacular giant sandcastle ever seen, with shells, seaweed, great views and lots of sand.

episodes.title: The Football Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels decide to play football. Duggee starts the game by kicking the ball to the Squirrels, who look at it blankly. They don't know what to do - they've never played football before. Worm, Hennie and Ethel do their best to show them the rules, but it's all going in the wrong direction. How will they ever score a goal?

episodes.title: The Puppet Show Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels had a great adventure outside and want to tell everyone about it. What better way to tell a story than through a puppet show? First they make the puppets, using scissors, card, glue, glitter and feathers. Then it's time for an amazing show for all their friends! But wait a minute... who is this unexpected guest in the big black car?

episodes.title: The Birdwatching Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee uses his trusty binoculars to do some birdwatching, and of course the Squirrels want to have a go too. The problem is, if you want to go birdwatching you have to be very, very quiet, otherwise the birds will fly away. And being very, very quiet is difficult when you have Roly with you. Bird! Bird! Bird! Can Roly remember to whisper? And is Duggee's sneeze just a little too loud?

episodes.title: The Big Parade Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee introduces the Squirrels to his friend Eugene, the leader of the Big Parade, who has lost his hat. The Squirrels find him a new hat to wear from their dressing-up box, and off Eugene goes. But then - oh dear! - he hurts his leg and can't lead the parade after all. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help out? You bet they can! Stand by for the best Big Parade ever!

episodes.title: The Be Careful Badge
episodes.summary: It's a beautiful day and everyone is outside enjoying themselves in the sunshine. Everything is peaceful until Naughty Monkey starts throwing banana skins down from his branch. That won't do at all! Ethel slips up and lands with a very big bump - be careful everyone! The Squirrels go and investigate. Then it's Naughty Monkey's turn to fall down... into a big hole. He's stuck! The Squirrels get Duggee and together they go to help Naughty Monkey, but they have to be very careful along the way.

episodes.title: The First Aid Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing Copy the King when Tag falls over and bumps his knee - ouch. Duggee has his first aid badge, so he can bandage Tag up. The Squirrels want to help and they practise their bandaging on Tag. They do pretty well at first, but hang on a minute... where has Tag gone? And why is that huge bandage ball rolling down the hill? Hurry up Squirrels - time for a chase!

episodes.title: The Bubble Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee has a pot of bubble mixture, and he is blowing fantastic bubbles. It is really hard to do, but most of the Squirrels eventually get the hang of it, and the clubhouse rapidly fills up with lots of bubbles. But poor old Happy just cannot get it right - until he comes up with a great idea, one that will make the biggest bubble ever! Just watch out for prickly old Hedgely!

episodes.title: The Submarine Badge
episodes.summary: It's a day out! Duggee and the Squirrels are off on an underwater adventure with Betty's dad in his submarine. They see all the wonders of the underwater world, including a giant sea stallion and some jazz fish. And to the Squirrels, all those coloured buttons that work the submarine are just as interesting as what is outside. Betty's dad has a tricky time amusing the Squirrels. Thank goodness for the school of fish!

episodes.title: The Detective Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee puts his delicious homemade apple pie on the windowsill to cool down, but the second his back is turned it's gone. Who took it? Can the Squirrels find out? Fortunately, Duggee has his detective badge - and there are some very small footprints to follow. The Squirrels go and find lots of clues to help Duggee solve the mystery. Being a detective is hard work!

episodes.title: The Sewing Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is sewing a snazzy poncho, and the Squirrels want to make one too. They all get down to some sewing and it's very quiet in the clubhouse... until they hear a very loud sneeze! It's so loud that everything starts to shake. Where is it coming from? Duggee and the Squirrels go off and investigate, following the sneezes all the way to a polar bear with a very bad cold. He needs a hanky. What could they use instead?

episodes.title: The Surprise Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels have bought Hennie a present for her birthday, but first they need to wrap it up. It's very big and will need rather a lot of paper and sticky tape. The Squirrels each choose some colourful paper and get wrapping. It's all going very well until the very last bit of paper and sticky tape. Whoever said this was going to be easy?

episodes.title: The Teddy Bear Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels take their teddy bears out for a picnic. But hang on - who does that huge teddy belong to? Oh! That's not a teddy at all! It's Beryl, and she's a real bear! She wants to join in the fun but has no teddy of her own, so the Squirrels make her one using sticks, leaves, acorns... and a big pink sock! Now Beryl can join the picnic with everyone else.

episodes.title: The Story Badge
episodes.summary: It's a busy day at the clubhouse! The Squirrels are doing everything - reading, drawing, watering plants, running, dancing, making things, splashing in water and much more. They're so busy that they tire themselves out, so Duggee suggests they have a break and listen to a story with milk and cookies. Good idea, Duggee. He reads the Squirrels a story about Cookie the dog. It's a simple little story... that is, until the Squirrels join in with their ideas!

episodes.title: The Making Music Badge
episodes.summary: When the Squirrels find Duggee playing saxophone, they want to have a go too. Several pots, balloons, tins, water and tubes later and the squirrels are making music. And boy, are they LOUD!

episodes.title: The Whistling Badge
episodes.summary: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The Squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

episodes.title: The Shape Badge
episodes.summary: It is a lovely day and the Squirrels are playing outside. They are playing the shape game. Working out which shape goes where is quite tricky.

episodes.title: The Juice Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is going to make the Squirrels juice from fresh fruit in the garden. Whilst picking the fruit, the Squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small. The Squirrels think it must be brilliant to be so tiny but the little bug disagrees.

episodes.title: The Footprint Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing hide and seek but they can't find Happy. Duggee can though - he follows Happy's footprints. The Squirrels follow lots of different footprints that take them to their friend but there is one set they just can't work out.

episodes.title: The Fossil Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are digging in the garden when they come across a fossil, so Duggee and Narrator explain all about fossils and prehistoric times. When the Squirrels go outside, it seems like they've gone right back in time.

episodes.title: The Treehouse Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is cleaning the clubhouse so the Squirrels take refuge in the treehouse, but it's getting a little bit cramped these days. Norrie has an idea - maybe they need to add an extension, just like her dad does when she gets new siblings.

episodes.title: The Kite Badge
episodes.summary: It's a very windy day and the Squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly. Well done Squirrels! What brilliant flags!

episodes.title: The Tadpole Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool, a place of calm for all the animals. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles! But they don't sound or look like Frog.

episodes.title: The Honey Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee's made some delicious pancakes, but the clubhouse is out of honey. Time for the bees to get busy!

episodes.title: The Pottery Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is having a lovely cup of tea in his favourite cup when Roly surprises him with a very loud PEEK-A-BOO! It is so loud that Duggee jumps and drops his cup which shatters into pieces. Time for a bit of pottery!

episodes.title: The Teamwork Badge
episodes.summary: A big box is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are very excited. What could be inside? Oh! It is a huge box of bits and pieces. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work very hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

episodes.title: The Dancing Bug Badge
episodes.summary: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop dancing. The Squirrels take a close look and see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a whole band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

episodes.title: The Train Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is playing with his train set. Choo-choo! It's amazing. The squirrels are curious and want to know all about it. Duggee explains that it is a toy but it works exactly like a real train. Hennie arrives and she has a train too. The squirrels ask if they can play with it. You can't play with it; you can play IN it says Hennie. All aboard!

episodes.title: The Pizza Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are... interesting!

episodes.title: The Medicine Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is not very well - he has lost his voice. The Squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water, but the Squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

episodes.title: The Camping Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels are going camping. They need to find somewhere to pitch their tent but it's not as easy as they thought it would be. They all work together and finally get settled. But Tag realises he can't sleep without his teddy, and Happy would like a glass of water. Suddenly Duggee is up and down and in and out of the tent getting everything the Squirrels need. In fact, Duggee works so hard that he's the first to fall asleep.

episodes.title: The Making Friends Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are off for a jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee, but everything they do is different - even Roly finds one of them too LOUD!

episodes.title: The River Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right to the other end of the river, a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the Squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his river badge!

episodes.title: The Yoga Badge
episodes.summary: It's one of those days. The Squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his yoga badge.

episodes.title: The Collecting Badge
episodes.summary: When they see Duggee cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects, the Squirrels are inspired to start their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

episodes.title: The Shadow Badge
episodes.summary: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! There's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything. Thank goodness Duggee has got his torch - and he has torches for everyone.

episodes.title: The Theatre Badge
episodes.summary: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all-singing, all-dancing extravaganza, while the other wants a serious drama. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

episodes.title: The Memory Badge
episodes.summary: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it! He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The Squirrels start to look for it but they can't find the tooth anywhere. Time to think carefully and remember!

episodes.title: The Going Slow Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to enjoy things at a slower pace. However, they soon come across Tortoise, who needs to get to the hospital as his wife is having babies. Duggee and the Squirrels need to get him there fast!

episodes.title: The Obstacle Course Badge
episodes.summary: It's time for the annual animal obstacle course race. The animals need to work together in teams to complete the course. Duggee has his obstacle course badge. He and the Squirrels form the RED team and the fun begins.

episodes.title: The Spooky Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing dress-up when they hear a ghostly sound. They can see that something has spooked the chickens, so they stop what they are doing to investigate. They come across several different items, such as ghostly white footprints, and then they spot a floating sheet. What is going on? The Squirrels will have to take the long way round if they want to catch whatever it is.

episodes.title: The Space Badge.
episodes.summary: It's winter and it's dark and too cold to play outside. The Squirrels wonder what Duggee is up to, he seems to be looking through a long stick out of the window. What's that, Duggee? Duggee explains that it's a telescope, and he's looking at things far far away in space. The Squirrels are keen to have a go too but first Duggee tells them about the solar system, and in order to help him they must all dress up as planets!

episodes.title: The Harvest Badge
episodes.summary: It's that beautiful time of the year. The birds are tweeting and all the crops are looking ripe and ready to pick. Duggee is getting ready to harvest them. The Squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all. But there are lots of crops, and this could take forever!

episodes.title: The Colour Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book. The Squirrels want to have a go too. Betty wants to paint a bee and that's yellow. Tag paints a fire truck and that's red, and Happy paints some water blue. But when it's Norrie's turn she can't find the paint colour she wants. Don't worry, Duggee has his colour badge, he can mix colours together to make different colours. What other colours can you make, Duggee?

episodes.title: The Stick Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. It's all very exciting. Duggee is getting it ready and needs the Squirrels to help find lots of wood for it. He needs small sticks, medium size sticks and big sticks. Off they go to look, but there are so many different shapes and sizes. The Squirrels are busy collecting when Roly finds a stick with eyes that pop open! And that's not all. This stick can talk too!

episodes.title: The Voice Badge
episodes.summary: It's just a normal day at the clubhouse, the Squirrels are all busy playing. Duggee is doing a spot of washing. Is that a wizard's hat, Duggee? Woof, how curious! He even has a wand too. The Squirrels are looking at a bird on Happy's nose. 'Where have you come from, little bird?' Baa! Did she just Baa like a sheep? Yes, she did. Then the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices (was that really Betty yelling like Roly? Why is Tag saying 'splash' like Happy?). It's clear something has gone awry. Don't worry, Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do.

episodes.title: The Island Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. There's so much to see! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick, Duggee suggests they stop at the island for a spot of lunch. But where's all the food? The picnic basket is empty, everything is still on board and the boat is drifting out to sea! Thank goodness Duggee has his island badge. He knows what to do.

episodes.title: The Sleeping Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. But Tag can't sleep. Don't worry, Duggee can help. He has his sleeping badge. While the other Squirrels sleep, he tells Tag how other animals sleep and describes a few tricks they use to get to sleep. But will anything help to get Tag to sleep?

episodes.title: The Brave Banana Badge
episodes.summary: It's a stormy day outside. The Squirrels are busy playing and Duggee is making banana muffins. A big dark cloud hovers over the clubhouse, it wobbles and we hear a massive BOOM! A loud clap of thunder! Suddenly there is a flash of white light. It turns out the Squirrels are scared of lightning. Fortunately, Duggee has his brave banana badge, so he knows exactly how to help them overcome their fears.

episodes.title: The Water Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels have been running around playing games and they're very thirsty. Duggee gives them all a big drink of water. Happy is mesmerised by the dripping tap. Drip, drip, drip. Turn it off, Happy, we mustn't waste water. But the Squirrels think water is limitless, and they explain where they think it comes from.

episodes.title: The Traffic Badge
episodes.summary: It's a hot day, so Duggee is treating the Squirrels to a trip to the tropical lake. The Squirrels are on Duggee's back with their arm bands and inflatable toys, and they are very excited! But lots of people have had the same idea today and there's a traffic jam. It looks like Duggee and the Squirrels might be stuck for some time. Thank goodness Duggee has his traffic badge. He knows what to do.

episodes.title: The Dressing Up Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is wrapping a present because it's Enid's birthday. But the Squirrels didn't get her anything! Maybe they could give her a surprise? But Enid doesn't like surprises. What about a cake? Oh no, Enid doesn't like cake either. Norrie suggests dressing up. What a great idea! But how will they have a dressing up party? Don't worry, Duggee has his dressing up badge. He knows what to do.

episodes.title: The Getting On Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing noisily outside the clubhouse. Suddenly a mole appears from a mound close by and asks them to keep the noise down. What noise? ask the Squirrels innocently. But there is lots of banging and popping. Fox, Badger, Mole, Vole and Worm all appear out of their underground homes. Unfortunately they are not getting on. Can Duggee and the Squirrels intervene and suggest ways that they can all live underground peacefully?

episodes.title: The Wedding Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing at the clubhouse when there is a knock at the door. It's delivery Chipmunk with a special delivery for Duggee and the Squirrels. Duggee opens the envelope and takes out the card inside: 'It is with very great pleasure that I invite Duggee and the Squirrels to my wedding.' King Tiger has met his perfect partner and is getting married. It's going to be a royal wedding!

episodes.title: The Grandparents Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels are tidying up because it's Bring Your Grandparents to Squirrel Club Day. Duggee has his grandparents badge so he knows what they will like - a nice cup of tea! But on arrival, these grandparents seem more of a lively bunch than Duggee was expecting.

episodes.title: The Organising Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels decide it is time to tidy up. Luckily, Duggee has his organising badge, and with the help of the Squirrels he reorganises everything in the clubhouse. When they have finished, they head outside... but how best to organise the animals?

episodes.title: The Looking After Badge
episodes.summary: Outside the clubhouse, a large crowd has gathered around a hot-air balloon with whisperings that someone is going on an adventure! It's Phileas Frog and Flea, and they are about to start their expedition around the world in a balloon. They set sail and wave their goodbyes to the crowd, when suddenly Flea realises he has forgotten Pippin, their potted plant! Roly runs through the crowd, promising 'we'll look after it!' Hooray! They can set off!

episodes.title: The Comedy Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels go to see what Duggee is doing, but on the way Tag stumbles on some toy blocks and hurts his knee. How can they make him feel better? Happy's mum always says laughter is the best medicine. But how will they make Tag laugh? A-woof... maybe Duggee can help, he does have his comedy badge!

episodes.title: The Singing Badge
episodes.summary: It's a lovely day. Duggee and the Squirrels are out on a walk in the countryside. It's been a long walk and the Squirrels are starting to get tired, but it's a long way back. Don't worry, Duggee has his singing badge. If they sing a song, they will be back before they know it. Duggee starts to sing a song and marches ahead, while the Squirrels march behind him and join in. Hold on, what's that noise? It's Mrs Weaver the beaver, and she's struggling to get her cubs to sleep with all that noise!

episodes.title: The Playing Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing in the clubhouse when Naughty Monkey arrives and causes chaos! He later returns to his home to relax, but there is a knock at his door. It's his cousins, who have come to visit. But it turns out they are even naughtier than Naughty Monkey!

episodes.title: The Party Badge
episodes.summary: Bing Bong! There's somebody at the door. It's Delivery Chipmunk with a parcel for Duggee, but why is it wrapped up like a present? Maybe it's Duggee's birthday! The Squirrels decide they should have a party, but they will have to keep it a secret as it's a very BIG surprise.

episodes.title: The Tour Guide Badge
episodes.summary: It's a hot day and Duggee is watering the plants. The Squirrels help and after a while everything is wet and slippery. Roly slides along the grass, but hang on - that's not grass! Roly is sliding on a really long snake! Gerbie the snake is on holiday and would like to see all the beautiful sights. Duggee can help - he does have his tour guide badge!

episodes.title: The Sailing Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels are enjoying a day at the beach. Suddenly a great shadow comes over them as they are dwarfed by a giant, regal sailing ship that has run aground on the beach. The Squirrels go to investigate. They encounter the Penguins who explain they were on a very important mission when they got sick. They need to head to a nearby island, but they are too poorly to sail the ship. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help?

episodes.title: The Key Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are playing outside. Roly is digging in the garden when his spade suddenly hits something. It's a key. But what does it do? Duggee has his key badge and says they can find out through trial and error. The Squirrels go on an adventure to work out what the key opens and what could be inside.

episodes.title: The Fashion Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels find Duggee cleaning and repairing his collection of antiques. He has to take special care of them because they are very old. A bit like your shirt, says Tag. Duggee's uniform is a bit patchworked and old, and it has been quite a while since he made an outfit... You see, Duggee can make his own clothes!

episodes.title: The Glasses Badge
episodes.summary: It's a lovely day outside and Duggee is watering the plants while the Squirrels play nearby. Happy goes to retrieve a ball and finds Mole sitting on a bench looking very sad. Mole is reflecting on missed opportunities and forgotten dreams. As a young mole he wanted to be... a stunt mole! But he couldn't follow that dream as it was too hard with his vision being so fuzzy. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help?

episodes.title: The Being Quiet Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature called The Snard who doesn't like noise…time to earn their Being Quiet badges!

episodes.title: The Duck Badge
episodes.summary: The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum, so Duggee and the Squirrels need to do some detective work to reunite them with their real mum.

episodes.title: The Tooth Brushing Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels meet a lion with unfortunate breath and teach him a special song to help him learn how to brush his teeth.

episodes.title: The Camouflage Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings, earning their Camouflage Badges in the process!

episodes.title: The Get Indoors Badge
episodes.summary: A severe weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

episodes.title: The Day Off Badge
episodes.summary: It's Duggee's day off, but it's not long before the Squirrels show up to tell him about their adventures on their own days off - earning their Day Off badges in the process!

episodes.title: The Pen Pal Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals, helping them to learn all about life in far away places, earning their Pen Pal badges and making some new friends in the process!

episodes.title: The Big Day Out Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee takes the Squirrels and their parents on an exciting mystery trip, where they learn they can make anywhere special and earn their Big Day Out badges in the process!

episodes.title: The Tree Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee helps the Squirrels learn about all the amazing things trees do for the creatures who live among them, and earn their tree badges in the process!

episodes.title: The Cheese Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels go on a mission to contain an outbreak when Roly inadvertently goes on the run with the world's smelliest cheese, earning Cheese badges in the process.

episodes.title: The Radio Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels stumble upon Duggee's old radio equipment and discover that Duggee used to have his own radio show. The Squirrels decide to start their own, earning their Radio Badges and lots of fans.

episodes.title: The Opposites Badge
episodes.summary: When Roly does the opposite of what Norrie asks him to do, she struggles to describe what an 'opposite' is. Luckily, Duggee has his Opposites Badge, so he and some animal friends explain everything.

episodes.title: The Breakfast Badge
episodes.summary: Tag is feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast. Luckily, Duggee has his Breakfast Badge, and soon the Squirrels will too.

episodes.title: The Family Photo Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is putting up a picture of himself with his old friends. This inspires the Squirrels to take a photo of their own, but Duggee then spends a long time searching for everyone who should be in it.

episodes.title: The Future Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are transported into the future, where they encounter a robot version of Duggee as well as a few other interesting changes to the clubhouse.

episodes.title: The Philosophy Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels think about life's big questions, helping Tino the Artistic Mouse escape a crisis of confidence and gaining their Philosophy Badges in the process.

episodes.title: The Sharing Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels are baking. But if there are six bakers and only one pie, how will they all get to eat? Luckily, Duggee has his Sharing Badge and shows the Squirrels how to divide things up.

episodes.title: The History Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are curious about what happened 'a long, long time ago'. So Duggee takes them on a trip through time, where they meet a host of characters from the past and earn their History Badges.

episodes.title: The Art Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels learn about different types of art and what inspires them while preparing their own pieces for Tino the Artistic Mouse's Woodland Biennale.

episodes.title: The Crazy Golf Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels practice their golf swing in some interesting conditions in pursuit of their Crazy Golf Badges and the ultimate prize - a round of milkshakes!

episodes.title: The Mystery Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels go to a fancy party at King Tiger's house and become embroiled in a mystery when the prized ruby centrepiece disappears from his party crown.

episodes.title: The Election Badge
episodes.summary: Eugene is retiring from running as leader of the annual summer fair and he needs somebody else to take over and replace him. Duggee and the Squirrels suggest they hold an election to make things fair.

episodes.title: The Mixtape Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are exploring in the attic when they find an old cassette tape. They decide to make a mixtape for Duggee to remind him of all the happy memories they've made while earning their badges.

episodes.title: The Taste Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is making a smoothie, and the Squirrels can't agree on whether it's delicious or horrible. So they make their own adventurous smoothies using their favourite flavours to discover what taste is.

episodes.title: The Biology Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee and the Squirrels hop inside the Biology Bus and miniaturise themselves to go on a voyage of discovery inside Enid. Can they find out what's making her cough?

episodes.title: The Puddle Badge
episodes.summary: Happy sees a very questionable-looking puddle that he is determined to splash in, much to the horror of Duggee, the other Squirrels and the tiny citizens of Midgetropolis who live inside it!

episodes.title: The Game Show Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels have played all of their board games, so Duggee entertains them by putting on a game show, with some help hosting from his good friend Ladybug.

episodes.title: The Round Up Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and his old pal Rodeo Horse, who teaches them how to be cowhands and earn their Round Up Badges!

episodes.title: The Favourite Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels learn what a favourite is but have trouble deciding what their own favourite things are. So they make a film asking some of their friends what is special to them to help narrow it down.

episodes.title: The Topiary Badge
episodes.summary: When the Squirrels see Duggee practising his impressive topiary skills they are keen to try some of their own – and promptly put their new talents into practice in order to tame some very wild woods!

episodes.title: The A Cappella Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.

episodes.title: The Christmas Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee's old friend arrives at the Clubhouse, but he has lost his Christmas cheer. He used to love Christmas, but everything seems to be getting bigger, louder and faster, and it's exhausting!

episodes.title: The Babysitting Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee has a job to do outside the Clubhouse, but who will look after the Squirrels? King Tiger, of course, since he has his babysitting badge! But it's actually the Squirrels who end up babysitting King Tiger.

episodes.title: The Comic Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They are eager to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued! Luckily, Duggee has the comic badge, so he can show the Squirrels how to create their own ending.

episodes.title: The Senses Badge
episodes.summary: Roly has lost his best potato, but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses and earn their senses badge.

episodes.title: The Diplomacy Badge
episodes.summary: Betty and Sergeant Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.

episodes.title: The Buddy Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.

episodes.title: The Bridge Badge
episodes.summary: It's bridge building time! The Squirrels help a quarreling group of Gerbils sort out their longstanding disagreement.

episodes.title: The Soap Opera Badge
episodes.summary: After breaking the Chickens' TV aerial during the finale of their favourite soap opera, the Squirrels take it upon themselves to recreate the final episode for them. But will their performance impress the grumpy Chickens?

episodes.title: The Mythical Creature Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures. They learn and discover a wide range of mythical creatures, create their own and find out why the book was hidden in the first place.

episodes.title: The Counting Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels try the ultimate achievement of counting to 100 to earn their counting badge.

episodes.title: The What Happened Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels try and tell us what has just happened but are struggling to retell the story correctly.

episodes.title: The Telling Time Badge
episodes.summary: John the Crab needs help planning a surprise party for Nigel. It will only work if everyone is on time with the preparations.

episodes.title: The Puzzle Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle when the Naughty Mice steal their last piece. To get it back, they must take part in a series of puzzles in an underground adventure set by the Puzzle Mouse.

episodes.title: The Action Hero Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels learn about an action hero called Jet Rocket who always saves the day by smashing and crashing things. But there are other ways to save the day!

episodes.title: The Training Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee struggles to organise the Squirrels in order of height and keep them focused on the task. Sounds like the Squirrels need some training to improve their concentration.

episodes.title: The Reunion Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee hosts a reunion for the first ever Squirrels he looked after. But the first ever Squirrels are older now and very similar to the Squirrels' parents. Does that mean that when the Squirrels are bigger, they will become like their parents, too?

episodes.title: The Board Game Badge
episodes.summary: It is a rainy day in the clubhouse, which means it's a perfect day for a board game. Duggee introduces the Squirrels to one of his favourite games, but it might be just a little bit too complex for them.

episodes.title: The Direction Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels go out for a walk but can't find a way back to the clubhouse. Through a series of unusual methods, the Squirrels learn all about direction and how to find their way to the clubhouse.

episodes.title: The Perfume Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels make their very own perfumes with accompanying advertisements to show how their perfumes are uniquely theirs.

episodes.title: The Building Block Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels become architects so they can design, build and bring to life their very own clubhouse.

episodes.title: The Walking Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels learn the many ways you can walk with the help of friends and a catchy song.

episodes.title: Norrie's First Day
episodes.summary: Norrie skips into the Clubhouse and greets her friends. As they greet her, they reminisce about when they first met. Arriving with her parents in a long limousine, Norrie, her parents and her 72 siblings flood out of the car. It's just Norrie who is going to stay at the Clubhouse, though, and enjoy some well-needed quiet. She can play alone and hear herself think! But after a while, she misses the hustle and bustle, so Duggee introduces Norrie to Enid the cat. Together they venture into the Clubhouse and Norrie has a friend so she isn't alone, but she still has a little bit more room than she would have at home!

episodes.title: The Lost Property Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels have just got some new walkie-talkies and are having so much fun with them. Duggee calls the Squirrels to come for some blueberry juice, but as Tag is running, he trips over a car and falls through a secret door in the wall! Communicating through his walkie-talkie, Tag doesn't know where he is. He can see lots and lots of things around him, but no-one has any idea where this room is in the house. As Duggee listens to Tag describe what's in the room, he realises that Tag must be in the lost property room. But Duggee doesn't know where in the house that is. He's going to need to go find the map of the house which he has hidden somewhere. Whilst Tag explores all the treasures of the lost property room, the Squirrels search for hints to where the map could be around the Clubhouse. Finally, after looking all over the house, Betty finds the code on a piece of paper, opens the safe and gets the map. Tag has been entertaining himself dancing with a lion statue and playing a church organ. Duggee still can't remember where the lost property room is, so Tag gives him some tips for remembering where you might have left something when you lost it. Take a deep breath, think of where you were last time you had it and.... boom! Duggee remembers he put wallpaper over the lost property room door! The Squirrels and Duggee find where the door is and enter into a room filled with stuff - and also Tag!

episodes.title: The Mountain Badge
episodes.summary: When the Squirrels search for Enid, they are surprised to hear her meow from the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain. The Squirrels prepare for the climb to rescue Enid, but first Duggee teaches them what they need to pack in their backpacks for a successful trip. The team walk through rocky terrain, grey skies, plentiful rain and snow blizzards but keep morale high as they learn how phrasing negative thoughts into helpful ones will let them overcome any challenges along the way. The Squirrels repeat their positive affirmations to keep climbing up the Sugar Bun as a team, and when they find themselves at the top of the mountain, they all give Enid a big hug. A successful rescue mission means Happy can have his nap on the sofa with Enid when they are back!

episodes.title: The Accessory Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee thought his tie was a little bit plain, so he added some accessories and now it looks amazing. The Squirrels admire Duggee's new look and want to learn how to accessorise themselves. The first step for the Squirrels is to find something they'd like to change. The Squirrels each bring a different item - wellies, a T-shirt, headband, helmet and... a potato. They grab sequins, patches, feathers and lights, and then showcase what they have all done. Norrie has added sequins to her T-shirt and made it into a new wonderfully sparkly outfit. Betty has added loads of useful items to her headband, like a calculator and a pencil, to wear it on all occasions. Roly has painted glow-in-the-dark paint on his wellies, and now he can splash in the dark. Tag has painted his helmet and added horns so he looks super-turbo! Roly has turned his potato into a beautifully made-up face with pink and yellow hair. The Squirrels want to accessorise everything. Soon enough, the whole of the Clubhouse and the town are new and improved, but the Squirrels are getting tired. There's a chance they may have got carried away, so they go to work toning it down a touch. Less is more!

episodes.title: The Ambition Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks, so the Squirrels start to think about what their ambitions might be. Norrie wants to learn how to break dance. Happy has always wanted to jump the famous triple puddle splash. Betty has always wanted to teach Mr Cuddles how to speak Portuguese. Roly has loads, from growing a potato to becoming a pirate. Tag spends a long time thinking what his could be, and then it clicks - he needs to climb over the log! Duggee gets to work helping all of the Squirrels train so they can reach their goals. Duggee teaches them that while it may be hard, the important thing is to keep trying and eventually you'll get there. The Squirrels achieve their ambitions, and Tag successfully climbs over the log. Now they have achieved their first ambitions, the Squirrels can continue to reach for the stars. And they know Duggee is proud of them no matter what they achieve, and that they should be proud of themselves!

episodes.title: The Rainbow Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

episodes.title: The Dream Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!

episodes.title: The Eating Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like giraffes, and some eat food that is very low down, like moles. The Squirrels finish off their picnic, having learned a lot about all the different ways of eating.

episodes.title: The Same Badge
episodes.summary: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way. All while Otti tries to avoid playing with the boat whistle! The Hummingbirds see the likes of meerkats, an aye-aye and snapping turtles and soon bump into some friendly faces - Duggee and the Squirrels! They are delivering a parcel upstream too. They reach their destination at the same time, and Otti and Roly finally get to sound the boat whistle. They are all directed towards a mysterious-looking cave where Chew Chew is waiting for both parcels. They deliver them at the same time, but they contain different things - one is full of biscuits and the other organic almond milk. They aren't the same but they go really well together, just like the Squirrels and Hummingbirds!

episodes.title: The Carrot Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are admiring everything Duggee has grown in his vegetable garden, especially his crop of giant carrots, when they hear a noise. They investigate and find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice, the day when the sun is at its highest. On this day, they gather round Carrot Henge to celebrate the glory of this humble vegetable. Trouble is, the Rabbits need to go and get ready - but who will look after the carrots? The Squirrels volunteer, so off the Rabbits go. Looking after the carrots seems easy at first, and Norrie arranges tasks for everyone. Betty skillfully organises the queue while Roly is on toilet duty. And then, disaster strikes. Worm pops up and eats part of Carrot Henge. Duggee is dispatched to fetch one of his own giant carrots to fill the gap. As time ticks on with no Duggee in sight, the place gets busier, and the sun is nearly at the top. Will Duggee fix the Henge in time, or will Carrot Solstice be ruined?

episodes.title: The Face Painting Badge
episodes.summary: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

episodes.title: The Transport Badge
episodes.summary: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back.

episodes.title: The Talent Badge
episodes.summary: Out for a walk, the squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part.

episodes.title: The Mime Badge
episodes.summary: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny.

episodes.title: The Why Badge
episodes.summary: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one - Tag. His feet hurt. Poor Tag. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.
